camel_example: aliyun agentidentity ListIdentityProviderDepartments --region cn-hangzhou --IdentityProviderType DingTalk --UserPoolName 'syncscope-example' --version 2025-09-01 --method POST --force
description_en: Queries a paginated list of direct child departments of a configured DingTalk or Lark identity source in a user pool
description_zh: 查询用户池中已配置的钉钉或飞书身份源的直属子部门列表，支持分页
kebab_example: aliyun agentidentity list-identity-provider-departments --user-pool-name syncscope-example --identity-provider-type DingTalk --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListIdentityProviderDepartments

parameters.help_en: The name of the user pool. The name must be 3 to 64 characters in length and start with a letter or a digit. The remaining characters can only be letters, digits, underscores (_), and hyphens (-)
parameters.help_zh: 用户池名称。长度为3～64个字符，以字母或数字开头，其余字符仅允许字母、数字、下划线和短划线
parameters.name: user_pool_name

parameters.help_en: The type of the identity source. This parameter is case-sensitive. Valid values: DingTalk: DingTalk. Feishu: Lark
parameters.help_zh: 身份源类型，区分大小写。DingTalk表示钉钉，Feishu表示飞书
parameters.name: identity_provider_type

parameters.help_en: The identifier of the parent department. If this parameter is not specified or is an empty string, DingTalk uses the string 1 for the root department by default, and Lark uses the string 0 for the root department by default. DingTalk departments use strings in the form of positive integers, and non-root Lark departments use open_department_id
parameters.help_zh: 父部门标识。不传或为空字符串时，钉钉默认使用根部门字符串1，飞书默认使用根部门字符串0。钉钉部门使用正整数形式的字符串，飞书非根部门使用open_department_id
parameters.name: parent_department_id

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of departments to return per page. Valid values: 1 to 50. If this parameter is not specified in the first request, the default value is 20. If this parameter is not specified in subsequent requests, the page size in the pagination token is used. If this parameter is explicitly specified, it must be the same as the value in the previous request
parameters.help_zh: 每页最多返回的部门数，取值为1～50。首次请求不传时默认为20；续页不传时沿用分页标记中的页大小，显式传入时必须与前页相同
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The pagination token. Do not specify this parameter in the first request. For subsequent requests, use the NextToken value returned from the previous request as is. The example only shows the format of an opaque string and cannot be directly used for actual pagination
parameters.help_zh: 分页标记。首次请求不传；续页时原样使用上一页返回的NextToken。示例仅展示不透明字符串的形式，不能直接用于实际分页
parameters.name: next_token

schema.description_en: The result returned when the operation is successful
schema.description_zh: 接口调用成功时的返回结果

Departments.description_en: The list of direct child departments on the current page. The list does not include the parent department itself. If no departments are available, an empty array is returned
Departments.description_zh: 本页直属子部门列表，不包含父部门本身。没有可返回的部门时为空数组

items.description_en: The information about a direct child department
items.description_zh: 一个直属子部门的信息

HasChildren.description_en: Indicates whether direct child departments exist. Valid values: true: Direct child departments exist. false: No direct child departments exist
HasChildren.description_zh: 是否存在直属子部门。true表示存在，false表示不存在

Id.description_en: The identifier of the department. Numeric department identifiers of DingTalk are also returned as strings
Id.description_zh: 部门标识。钉钉的数字部门标识也按字符串返回

MemberCount.description_en: The number of department members returned by the identity source. If the identity source does not return this value, it can be empty or omitted. A missing value cannot be interpreted as 0, nor does it represent the actual number of users to be synchronized after cross-department deduplication
MemberCount.description_zh: 身份源返回的部门成员数。身份源未返回时可为空或省略，不能将缺省解释为0，也不代表跨部门去重后的实际待同步人数

ParentId.description_en: The identifier of the parent department

NextToken.description_en: The pagination token for the next page. If no subsequent pages exist, this parameter is empty or omitted. Determine whether the pagination ends based on whether this value is empty. Do not stop pagination only because the Departments array on the current page is empty. The example only shows the format of an opaque string
NextToken.description_zh: 下一页分页标记。没有后续页时为空或省略。应以该值是否为空判断结束，不能仅因本页Departments为空停止。示例仅展示不透明字符串的形式

RequestId.description_en: The request ID, which is used to locate and troubleshoot the current call
RequestId.description_zh: 请求标识，用于定位和排查本次调用
